'''2014 US Nationals Day 1 Vince Hutchins LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Vince Hutchins]] at [[2014 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
